I am an old man, 76 years now, and I have farmed this land in Shinyanga since I was a boy. My plot is big, yes, but I do like my neighbors do — I put cattle manure where I can carry it, and I plant the seeds I saved from last harvest. Chemical fertilizer costs too much money and the rains here are not always kind, so I will not waste my shillings on it. My sons and grandsons help me in the field, and when the weeding time comes heavy I will call some young men from the village to help for a few days.
